posts.body:
Hello! For some reason a picture won't appear when it's supposed to? I genuinely have zero clue what I'm doing wrong here.
If it matters at all, the image is 544 x 416. Any help would be great!

posts.author: PhantomPixel
posts.body:
Hi! So, I have a couple of guesses here:
1.) Is the picture a .png? RPG Maker only allows the .png format for images.
2.) Have you moved the picture from the file directory or into a different folder at any point? If so, you might need to reselect it in RPG Maker, to "refresh it" so to speak.
